categories.main_business_segments: Dalian Demaishi Precision Technology Co., Ltd. is primarily engaged in the research, development, production, and sales of precision shafts and precision cutting parts. The company operates through multiple product categories including automotive precision components for window systems, powertrain systems, chassis and body systems, as well as industrial precision parts. The company also has two wholly-owned subsidiaries: Dalian Dexin Precision Manufacturing Co., Ltd. and Dalian Jinhuade Precision Shaft Co., Ltd., which engage in similar precision parts manufacturing and processing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies encompass advanced manufacturing processes including extrusion, rolling, grinding, milling, cutting, and critical heat treatment techniques. Key technological capabilities include high-precision ball screw and roller screw manufacturing, precision shaft hardening and grinding, automated production line design and implementation, and digital platform integration. The company has developed proprietary expertise in complex machining operations such as worm gear milling, hard turning, and precision inspection using advanced equipment from manufacturers like Zeiss and Mitutoyo.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major global automotive component suppliers including Bosch, DENSO, Aisin Seiki, Valeo, PHINIA, Mahle, Marelli, Schaeffler, Toyota Industries, Brose, LG Innotek, and others. End customers include major automotive manufacturers such as Tesla, BYD, Volkswagen, Audi, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Volvo, Toyota, Honda, Li Auto, NIO, XPeng, Xiaomi, and various Chinese automakers. The company also serves industrial sectors including robotics, automation equipment, and emerging fields like electric vehicles and autonomous driving systems.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Dalian, Liaoning Province, China, with operations in the Lüshun Economic and Technological Development Zone. The company has established a global presence with products sold to customers in Europe, Asia, North America, and other regions. Major markets include China (domestic sales representing 71.87% of revenue), Europe, Japan, South Korea, and North America, with international sales accounting for 28.13% of revenue in 2024.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the automotive supply chain, functioning as a Tier-1 and Tier-2 supplier of precision components. The company sources raw materials (primarily steel) from suppliers, manufactures precision parts through advanced machining processes, and supplies finished components directly to major automotive component suppliers and OEMs. The company maintains a complete and independent supply chain including procurement, production, and sales systems.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic priorities include advancing digital transformation and intelligent manufacturing through the 'Smart Demaishi' initiative, expanding new energy vehicle component development, and entering emerging sectors such as robotics, autonomous driving systems, and hydrogen fuel cell vehicles. R&D focus areas include high-precision ball screw and roller screw technology, worm gear machining, automated production line development, and digital platform integration. The company is investing in collaborative research with universities including Dalian University of Technology and Northeastern University on advanced manufacturing technologies.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of precision manufactured components to automotive suppliers and industrial customers. Revenue is recognized when control of goods transfers to customers, typically upon delivery and customer acceptance. The company operates on a 'make-to-order' business model with customers placing orders based on their production requirements. Revenue streams include sales of precision shafts, precision cutting parts, and industrial precision components, with no significant reliance on licensing, subscription, or other alternative revenue models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with both domestic and international precision component manufacturers. Key global competitors include established suppliers like Bosch, DENSO, Aisin Seiki, Valeo, Mahle, Marelli, and Schaeffler. Domestically, competitors include companies like Zhongwu Mechatronics, Weiling Automotive, Beehive Transmission, and others. The company positions itself as a leading domestic supplier in precision shafts and cutting parts, with technological capabilities comparable to international competitors, offering advantages in cost-effectiveness, service responsiveness, and supply chain flexibility.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized precision manufacturing enterprise with 2024 revenue of RMB 690.44 million, representing 6.77% growth from 2023 revenue of RMB 646.65 million. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 53.98 million in 2024, with a net profit margin of approximately 7.8%. Total assets reached RMB 1.042 billion at year-end 2024, with shareholders' equity of RMB 670.68 million. The company demonstrates steady growth with operating cash flow of RMB 113.16 million in 2024, indicating strong operational performance and cash generation capability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through advanced precision manufacturing capabilities, offering products with high accuracy, quality stability, and production efficiency that meet stringent automotive industry standards. Key competitive advantages include: proprietary manufacturing technologies and processes developed through continuous R&D investment; IATF16949 and ISO9001 certifications ensuring quality consistency; automated production capabilities enabling rapid customization and short delivery times; experienced technical team with deep industry expertise; and established relationships with global tier-1 suppliers. The company emphasizes its ability to deliver complex, customized precision components with superior quality at competitive costs, supported by intelligent manufacturing infrastructure and digital platform integration.
